summary: Phase 2 interim review — Step 3 of 12: Better Auth foundation (Step 2) plus runtime auth and workspace access (Step 3: requireUser, requireWorkspaceAccess, TenantContext from membership only, withRoute CSRF origin check, withAction, safe next redirects, proxy-based rolling session cookie renewal). Phase 2 is not complete; later steps add workspace creation, UI, invitations, mailer and rate limiting.
risks: Auth rate limiting is disabled until its dedicated step because it needs a trusted client IP source.
Better Auth stores raw session tokens in the sessions table; accepted with controls (HMAC-signed cookie, auth tables unreachable from application code).
AUTH_SECRET is validated on first auth use rather than at boot, so a missing value makes auth requests fail closed.
Email verification, password reset and the mailer are not implemented yet (later Phase 2 steps).
Gitleaks secret scanning runs only in CI.
recommended_next_action: Human review of Step 3, then explicit approval before Step 4 starts.
